mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling tightening monetary policy, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $550,000,000, signaling heightened retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS above the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth is < 2% over 6 months, signaling accommodative monetary policy without inflation pressure, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window during accommodative periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE by > 0.5% in 2 months, signaling improving labor market conditions, boosts investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST by > 10% in a quarter, signaling a strong housing market, enhances overall economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST and SPX returns remains below 0.12 over any 3-year rolling window.
